## Maintenance problem

What repeated development or maintenance task is difficult today?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the user-visible outcome. A specific file format or API is optional.

## Example

Show a command, code sample, or template that demonstrates the desired behavior.

## Alternatives

What existing approach have you tried?

## Scope notes

List compatibility, dependency, or security considerations.
